environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind a standard ALB with HTTP listener on port 443 (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). The application runs as a gunicorn worker with no memory protections. The ALB forwards all authenticated requests (session-based auth only). No seccomp or AppArmor profiles applied to the container.

config.runtime: gunicorn 21.2.0, Python 3.11, Django 4.2, Ubuntu 22.04 on EC2 t3.xlarge
config.alb_config: HTTPS listener, ACM certificate for server TLS, no mutual TLS
